# Anthropic IPO Is 'Multiple Times Oversubscribed' as Roadshow Begins


By OpenTools Team


·


November 12, 2026


Anthropic's roadshow kicked off with massive demand as the Claude maker's IPO is already multiple times oversubscribed, raising up to $90.4 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. Claude traffic surged 24% in October as the company heads toward a November 19 Nasdaq debut.


## The Roadshow Explodes Out of the Gate


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's initial public offering roadshow launched Tuesday and demand is already through the roof. The Claude chatbot maker has drawn orders for multiple times the stock on offer,[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-11/anthropic-s-mega-ipo-is-said-to-be-multiple-times-oversubscribed) reported Wednesday, driven by large anchor-style expressions of interest from institutional investors.


Through the IPO and a concurrent private placement, Anthropic and its co-founders could raise as much as **$90.4 billion combined** at the top of the price range, according to[Quartz](https://qz.com/anthropic-ipo-oversubscribed-roadshow-demand-111126) . That would surpass SpaceX's IPO earlier this year and set a new record for a stock market debut.


## The Numbers: $1.4 Trillion Valuation


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) is selling 825 million Class A shares priced between **$70 and $78 per share** , according to[Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/anthropic-ipo-raise-much-644-billion-latest-draft-prospectus-shows-2026-11-10/) . At the top of that range, the company would be valued at roughly **$1.4 trillion on a fully diluted basis** , which includes stock options and restricted stock. On a non-diluted basis the market value would be about $1 trillion.


The stock is expected to begin trading on the **Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19** under the ticker **ANT** . Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading the offering alongside more than 20 additional banks.


Anthropic also arranged a separate **$26 billion private placement** with cornerstone investors including[Google](https://opentools.ai/organizations/google) , Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron,[Microsoft](https://opentools.ai/organizations/microsoft) , and TSMC — a who's-who of the AI hardware and cloud ecosystem.


## Valuation Rollercoaster: From $2 Trillion to $1.4 Trillion


The $1.4 trillion figure is a significant step down from where expectations sat just weeks ago. The valuation has swung wildly: investors were discussing **close to $2 trillion as recently as six weeks ago** , then expectations settled around **$1.5 trillion** before large backers pressed for a lower number after an AI stock selloff last Thursday,[Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/anthropic-ipo-raise-much-644-billion-latest-draft-prospectus-shows-2026-11-10/) reported. In a note to viewers, Reuters described the swing as "a wild swing in valuation" that reflects broader uncertainty about how to price AI companies, adding that with the VIX fear index above 20, it's a more volatile moment to go public.


Still,[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's last private round — its **Series H in May 2026** — valued the company at **$965 billion** . Even at $1.4 trillion, that represents a roughly 45% premium in six months. And with the IPO now oversubscribed,[the Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/68bcba57-0575-44ee-80f4-2e5ea23a431e) reports that bankers are already preparing to increase the valuation to $1.5 trillion.


## Revenue and Traffic Both Surging


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's run-rate revenue hit **$81 billion as of October 31** , according to[Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/anthropic-ipo-raise-much-644-billion-latest-draft-prospectus-shows-2026-11-10/) . The company is promoting the offering through investor events including a live-streamed session Friday with CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon.


The financial metrics land alongside a traffic surge. Claude recorded roughly **1.3 billion web visits worldwide in October** , a 23.8% jump from September's 1 billion and Claude's biggest month ever, according to Similarweb data shared with[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/conormurray/2026/11/11/claude-posts-massive-month-over-month-traffic-boost-as-anthropic-ipo-looms/) . Year-over-year, Claude traffic is up **536.3%** — far exceeding any other top[AI chatbot](https://opentools.ai/tools/ai-chatbot) .


Claude remains third in web traffic behind ChatGPT (6 billion visits) and Gemini (2.6 billion), but jumped six spots to **No. 25 on Similarweb's most-visited websites list** . Meanwhile ChatGPT recovered to 6 billion visits — its best month in a year — and Gemini held steady at 2.6 billion.


## The Competitive Landscape


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's IPO is the first major test of public-market appetite for frontier AI companies. Rival **[OpenAI](https://opentools.ai/organizations/openai) confidentially filed for an IPO earlier this year** but has since said it won't launch in 2026, according to[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/conormurray/2026/11/11/claude-posts-massive-month-over-month-traffic-boost-as-anthropic-ipo-looms/) . That gives Anthropic a clear runway as the first major AI lab to hit public markets.


On the financial side, Anthropic draws a higher percentage of its revenue from enterprise customers compared to OpenAI,[ProShares](https://www.proshares.com/browse-all-insights/insights/anthropics-ipo-how-it-compares-with-openai) noted in a comparison analysis. OpenAI is currently raising a pre-IPO round at roughly $1.2 trillion and topped $10 billion in quarterly revenue, though operating losses remain high.


Morningstar analysts, meanwhile, told investors they[see Anthropic stock as undervalued](https://global.morningstar.com/en-ca/stocks/anthropic-we-see-stock-undervalued-ipo-pricing-range) in the current IPO pricing range — a bullish signal amid the broader AI stock turbulence.


## What This Means for Builders


For developers who build on Claude,[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's public listing matters in concrete ways. A well-funded Anthropic with public-market discipline means **continued investment in the Claude API, Claude Code, and the broader developer ecosystem** . The $26 billion private placement from chipmakers and cloud providers signals that the hardware supply chain is deeply committed — builders won't face compute shortages driven by Anthropic's own infrastructure gaps.


The oversubscription also validates Anthropic's safety-forward positioning. While some investors were spooked by the AI stock selloff, the incoming demand suggests the market believes Anthropic's enterprise-heavy revenue mix and measured approach to deployment are real competitive advantages, not just PR.


The roadshow continues through next week with the pricing expected around November 18 and trading to begin **November 19 on Nasdaq** under ANT.


## What to Watch Next


- **November 13** Dario Amodei and Jamie Dimon live-streamed investor event — potential for new product or revenue disclosures


- **November 18** Expected pricing date — bankers may push to $1.5 trillion valuation given oversubscription


- **November 19** First day of trading on Nasdaq under ticker ANT — watch for opening pop and volatility


- **Q4 2026** OpenAI IPO filing timeline — how Anthropic trades will heavily influence OpenAI's valuation ambitions
